hover-turn.prompt: The robot floats and slowly bobs up and down, then turns its head a little to the left, blinks its glowing eyes once, and turns back to look straight at the camera. Gentle slow camera dolly-in.

hover-arrive.prompt: The robot glides slowly into the center of the frame from slightly below, rising gently as if flying in, then settles into a steady hover facing the camera. Soft mint glow under the robot.

stamp-press.prompt: The robot keeps its arm attached to its body and lifts the stamp a little, then presses the stamp straight down in one firm motion, with a small bounce of the whole body. The hand never lets go of the stamp. Camera still.

point-glow.prompt: The robot keeps pointing to the right with its arm extended, its eyes glow brighter, and it leans slightly toward the right while floating. A soft beam of mint light shines from the robot toward the right side of the frame.
